ArchetypeProperty.Name: WarmupDuration
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Warm-up seconds before the match goes live (damage disabled)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: MatchDuration
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Live match length in seconds (0 = no time limit)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: ScoreLimit
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Kills needed to win instantly (0 = no score limit)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: VoteDuration
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Seconds the end-of-match map vote stays open

ArchetypeProperty.Name: MapList
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Comma-separated level paths offered in the map vote (empty = restart the current level)

NetworkProperty.Name: Phase
NetworkProperty.Description: Match phase: 0 warm-up, 1 live, 2 map vote

NetworkProperty.Name: PhaseTimeRemaining
NetworkProperty.Description: Seconds left in the current phase

NetworkProperty.Name: WinnerNetId
NetworkProperty.Description: Network entity id of the current leader / winner (0 = none)

NetworkProperty.Name: WinningMapIndex
NetworkProperty.Description: Index into the map list currently winning the vote
